sprint: Sprint 5 — LLM-Unblocked Generation and Publication Closure

repo_probe.verdict: ORG_AND_REPO_NOT_PROVISIONED — neither org aspose-slides-net nor target repo exists

blockers.resolution: Maintainer creates org=aspose-slides-net, then creates repo: name=Aspose.Slides.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples, default_branch=main, visibility=public

blockers.detail: GPT_OSS_MODEL not set — generation cannot proceed
slides.yml status=discovery_only, allowed_types=[]. Human must approve pilot launch.
blockers.resolution: Human approval: slides.yml status=active, allowed_types=[Compress, Convert, Merger]

activation_command_when_approved.step1: Maintainer provisions org aspose-slides-net and repo Aspose.Slides.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples
activation_command_when_approved.step2: Human updates slides.yml: status=active, allowed_types=[Compress, Convert, Merger]
activation_command_when_approved.step4: Review Convert (ToPdf static), Compress (in-place + pres.Save), Merger (Process array)
activation_command_when_approved.step5: Publish with APPROVE_LIVE_PR after all gates pass
